disease_profile.diagnosis: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection, Chronic (Stage 1 / Early / Acute)
disease_profile.stage: Diagnosed 6 weeks ago after presenting with acute retroviral syndrome (fever, rash, sore throat). Very recent diagnosis. Started ART immediately (within 2 weeks of diagnosis). CD4 was 680 cells/uL at diagnosis.
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Biktarvy (bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide) -- one tablet daily. Just started 4 weeks ago.
key_symptoms: Acute symptoms have resolved (fever and rash gone)
Mild nausea in the mornings since starting the medication
Anxiety and difficulty sleeping (new-onset, related to diagnosis)
disease_profile.trajectory: Too early to assess treatment response. Viral load at diagnosis was 285,000 copies/mL (high, typical of acute infection). CD4 was robust at 680. Physician has explained that early treatment offers the best long-term prognosis and that undetectable viral load is expected within 3-6 months.

demographics.occupation: Barista, also a part-time music student
demographics.education: Some college -- currently enrolled in community college music program

causes: His own behavior (partying, not using protection)
A specific person he believes may have given it to him
